summary: Wallowa County, OR lookout site: a 125-foot crow's nest from the 1920s in the Wallowa-Whitman National Forest, burned in the 1988 Teepee Fire; no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Brief record agrees with the register and firelookout.com on name, location, 5,440 ft and the 1988 burn. The Forest Association list says abandoned, not gone. Build date is decade-only (1920s), so the 1920 event year is a placeholder. The record's kind 'platform' does not match the register's '125' crows nest' or the Forest Association's 'Crowsnest' type; left for a human to judge. The record's photo licence reads 'All rights reserved' although the credit is National Archives Pacific Northwest Region; not changed here. The Tepee Butte map set (UNT) is dated 1988 and its description mentions a fire boundary, but it does not name a fire; no source read ties the lookout to that project. The 1988 New York Times article on the fire returned HTTP 403 and was not read. No source describes the site today.
